m: A *campfire* creeps up the legs of a *tall stool* until the whole stool starts to **burn**.
A *kicking foot* boots an *open crate* far down the road: now there is a long **distance** between you.
On the *soil*, a tailor swings a *halberd* through a bolt of cloth to **cut out** a new *robe*.
A *standing person* props a *door* against an *archway* on soft *grass*, and everything begins to **lean** to one side.
A *standing person* presses a *thumb* into a strip of *bamboo*, leaving a mark that serves as a **sign**.
With an *elbow* up and a *strong arm* ready, a farmer faces the bull in his *rice field*: so **brave**.
A tiny *bug* crawls onto an *ox horn* and the ox feels the light **touch**.
A *small speech bubble* floats over a *rice field* and a *tree*: the teacher gives an outdoor **lesson** on farming.
Kneel on the *grass*, fold a *blanket*, keep your *mouth* shut and lean on your *cane*: that is how you show **respect** to elders.
A *dog* opens one *mouth* and then another, howling loudly: it is starting to **cry**.
A *standing heart* walks through *grass* in a *village* full of a *thousand ants*, and at last begins to **understand** them.
Pile *soil* behind one *fence*, then another *fence*, and pack it hard: you have built a **wall**.
A *dragon* swoops down and snatches your *robe* in a surprise **raid**.
Bang a *knife* on a pot and shout with your *mouth*: you **summon** everyone to dinner.
A cheating fisherman is caught in his own *fishing net* to **punish** him.
A *standing person* steps between a *person* in danger and a beast with *horns*, holding *two planks* as a shield: a true **hero**.
Under a *cliff*, someone hammers a *nail* to hang a lamp in the big **hall**.
Raise a *shading hand* over your eyes, then lower it and **bow** to the honoured guest.
At the *workbench*, one careful *puff of breath* clears the dust from a tiny carving: how **skilful**.
A *standing person* hides a *shell* and a *standing knife* at their **side**.
Under the *sun*, two *crosses* mark a border tied with a *leather strap*: the gate to **Korea**.
Behind an *archway* stacked with *two planks*, an *eye* watches steam **emit** from a crack.
A *standing person* buys a *seedling top* with a borrowed *shell* and now owes a **debt**.
The *sun* rises slowly, long and **graceful** over the hills.
A *bug* sits by a hot *cauldron* and watches the ice inside **melt**.
A *standing heart* behind a *fence* counts a *shell* at each *cross* on the road every day: it is **used to** the routine.
A *child* lies in the sun with an ice cream, happy to **enjoy** the day.
A soldier in a *rice field* rests his *halberd* on the *soil*, jumps a *hurdle*, and pushes back the *curtains* to **wear** his helmet.
A small **child** climbs onto the *podium* in the *village* square and sings.
A *prowling dog* with a *wart* on its nose walks **as if** it were a lion.
Sit on a bundle of *grain stalk* and use two *spoons* as oars: you **ride** down the river.
A *helping hand* lifts two bags of *soil* onto a hook to **hang** them on the wall.
A *big man* raises a golden cup over his head: he has won the **prize**.
Cut a *silk thread* with a *knife* and open your *mouth* to **introduce** the new shop.
A *child* wraps up under a blanket so **thick** you can hardly see him.
A *silk thread* hangs straight down while one *person* climbs and another *person* follows: a **vertical** path.
On the *hillside*, a *podium* stands under the *sun* with a *cross* nailed across it to **block** the path.
A *small speech bubble* flies off *swift* as a bird to carry the **news**.
Through *water drops*, past a *stop sign*, a *trailing foot* splashes as you **wade** across the stream.
*Footsteps* lead to a *bent cross*, and a *knife* cuts all the way through it: a **thorough** job.
Pages hang on a *drying rack* and a *standing knife* trims them: ready to **publish** the magazine.
A *cross* and a pair of *scissors* measure out a rope **ten feet** long.
A *campfire* blazes under the hot *sun* until the firecrackers **explode**.
A black bird lands on a *plank* and caws: a **crow**.
*Footsteps* trudge behind a guard with a *war club*, forced into hard **labour**.
A *helping hand* lays paper over the *grass* in a *rice field* to **trace** its outline.
*Water drops* splash on a *cow head* and its *legs*: time to **wash** the cow.
A *king* rides a *horse* wearing a bright stone of **agate**.
An arrow hits one *bullseye*, then another *bullseye*, straight into the *heart*: you **suffer** greatly.
A *woman* adds a *pinch* of spice and the soup tastes **wonderful**.
Polish *gold coins* until they shine, play *music*, and dance on your *legs* in front of the **mirror**.
An open *mouth* under one *sun* and then another *sun*: all day long you **sing**.
A *campfire* keeps burning every *page* you try to read, and you get very **annoyed**.
Under a *tent*, write on a strip of *bamboo* to **sign** your name.
A *standing person* lives high on a *mountain* for a thousand years: an **immortal**.
*Footsteps* lead off to a *hide* far away: not this one, **that** one.
Two strings tangled on a *bow*: it will **not** shoot.
On a *sickbed* beside the *goal line*, the player lies with a strange **illness**.
A *standing person* copies every move of a *square* dancer to **imitate** her.
A *standing person* drops a *spoon* on a *page* and the whole table starts to **tilt**.
A *wood slice* nailed to a *cross* by the road: a **sign board**.
On the *hillside*, a *bent knife* hides above a *mortar* sunk in the ground: a **trap**.
A small creature perches on a *plank* and sings: a **bird**.
A *cart* crashes, and a *right hand* and another *right hand* clap over their ears at the **bang**.
Your *mouth* speaks and your finger points to your *nose*, then to all of us: **we**.
A *claw* pulls something up from the *grass* under a *tree*: a fresh **vegetable**.
A *green shoot* grows in the *gate*, so you **close** it carefully.
A *big man* digs all day in the *rice field*: he never stops trying to **strive**.
A *big man* throws a party in his *shed* to **celebrate** his birthday.
A *helping hand* waves the troops back: time to **withdraw**.
*Water drops* roll down from an *eye*: **tears**.
Leaves picked from the *grass* and steeped in hot water: **tea**.
On a *sickbed*, a patient feels an illness strike like an *arrow*: a sudden **disease**.
A *silk thread* ties a *pig snout* to a *blanket*: the odd link must be **fate**.
A *helping hand* scatters seeds across a *rice field* full of *animal tracks*: time to **sow**.
A full *moon* shines clear and **bright** over the lake.
Pile *soil* around a *tree* trunk to **stop** the water.
A *woman* ties a *ribbon* on the jug and pours warm **milk**.
A *child* stands by a *grain stalk* taller than him: harvest **season**.
Under an *archway*, a *lid* comes off a pot of bright **red** paint.
A *prowling dog* sleeps on a *blanket* with a bone in its *mouth*: a pet **dog**.
A *lying man* with *fur* growing out behind him: he has grown a **tail**.
A *standing person* bows before a *judge* in a solemn **ceremony**.
A *standing person* sneaks into a *tent* by the light of the *moon* with a *standing knife* to **steal**.
A *big man* runs over a *cross* and through the *grass*: he has to **rush**.
A *king* wears a necklace of *red lacquer* beads and one shining **pearl**.
Something tiny crawls toward the *bullseye*: a **bug**.
A *horse* stops by a *candle* at the inn, and the soldiers **station** there for the night.
A *child* on a *ski* falls through a **hole** in the ice.
Put a *stepladder* under the *roof* to fix it: that is the **suitable** tool.
Cut a herb from the *grass* with *scissors*: fragrant **mugwort**.
A *dancer* steps across a fallen *tree* over the river: a **bridge**.
Pour *water drops* on a *campfire* and another *campfire*: the soup cooks weak and **bland**.
*Feathers* flutter over a *rice field*, past a *hurdle* and *curtains*: a bird spreads its **wing**.
A *standing heart* gives a cold *glare*: full of **hate**.
A *mother* in a *slanted cap* points her *cane* at a *silk skein* with too many knots: **numerous** tangles.
Wind howls under the *roof*: the house is bitterly **cold**.
A *standing person* walks beside a goat with *horns*: a loyal **companion**.
A *right hand* covers your *mouth* as you let out a long **sigh**.
The *sun* lifts over a *plank* on the horizon: **dawn**.
In a *tent* under the *moon*, a doctor sets down a *standing knife*, and the patient's *heart* begins to **recover**.
*Water drops* rise past one *cross* under the *sun* and another *cross* under the *moon*: the **tide** comes in.
Bags of *rice* waiting to become a *good meal*: the village's store of **grain**.
A *silk thread* tied under the *roof*: a *standing person* pulls it and a *banknote* starts to **shrink**.
Throw a *fishing net* over the *soil* and push with your *elbow*: the runaway pig has to **stop**.
Cup an *ear* with your *right hand* to hear the *crowd* **gather** in the square.
*Footsteps* wear a narrow **path** through the field.
A *standing heart* walks into the *tent* and the *mouth* inside says **exactly** what it hoped to hear.
A *helping hand* points while you walk on your *legs* along the stall to **choose** the best fruit.
A *standing person* folds a *tethered arrow* into a *robe* and ties it up as a **bag**.
A *left hand* stirs a dead *campfire*: nothing left but **ash**.
A *helping hand* swoops over the *seedbed* to **catch** a frog.
*Footsteps* of an old *person* move along the road **slowly**.
A *king* shows a *person* a jewel with shining *bristles* of light: his greatest **treasure**.
Tall *grass* hangs down like a **curtain** at the stage.
The *sun* behind a *big man* under an *archway* makes his shadow **reflect** on the wall.
A *skeleton* slashes a *robe* with a *standing knife*, and the cloth starts to **crack** open.
*Wheat* sways behind *curtains* by *splashing water*: a calm, **peaceful** farm.
A *cauldron* rolled onto the *hillside* to **separate** two fields.
Knock on a *door* and call with your *mouth* until someone comes to **open** it.
*Crumbs* on top, a *big man* below: thin at the top, wide at the bottom, like something **sharp**.
A *heart* that always aims at the same *bullseye*: **loyal**.
Weaving a *silk skein* after a day in the *rice field*: you are so **tired**.
A *blaze* burns hot as one *campfire* sits on another: painful **inflammation**.
A *cart* and an *axe* left out under the *sun* for a day: a **temporary** camp.
A *standing person* looks at a *cross* on the map and opens their *mouth* to **estimate** the distance.
*Water drops* lift a *flat tyre* so it can **float** down the river.
Only dry *grass* around a *tombstone*: the land is **barren**.
A *standing person* lays *two planks* under a *cloth cover* with *sprinkles* on top and nudges it over with an *elbow* to **repay** a friend.
A *tree* falls across a road painted *yolk* yellow: **horizontal**.
A *helping hand* slams the lid of an *open crate*: you **refuse** to take it.
A *king* with a long *beard* climbs a *mountain* and finds a golden stone: how **lucky**.
A *standing heart* watches a *swan* on the lake and starts to **recall** the past.
A *child* sits by a single *melon* in an empty field: **lonely**.
Above a *rice field* on a *pedestal* sits a huge *nose*: the statue's **nose**.
Behind the *gate*, kids bang a *lid* and wave a *towel*: so **noisy**.
Two *horns* on top of a woolly body: a **sheep**.
A *mouth* hangs open over a *tree* trunk with a *blank stare*: completely **dull**.
Under the *cliff*, one teacher keeps a whole *swarm* of kids in line: very **strict**.
At the *crossroads*, a merchant hangs out scales to **weigh** goods.
Under the *moon*, a *cobra* curls up in a warm *blanket* like a baby in a **womb**.
*Rain* soaks a *teepee* until an *elbow* pokes out of a hole. Dry spots left: **zero**.
Even with a *strong arm*, he lives in a *cave*: he is **poor**.
A *person* drops his heavy bag by the road: time to **give up**.
At the *horse* stall, a *stone* is carved with each horse's **number**.
Two *red cheeks* glowing side by side: a bold, **impressive** blush.
A *woman* scrubs a *hide* with *water drops*: that is **granny** doing chores.
Over *two planks* and past an *elbow* floats a *ghost*: a wandering **soul**.
A *campfire* catches the *roof*: a **disaster**.
*Water drops* pour over a *hurdle* and through the *curtains*: a **flood**.
